messages:
alina: Kicking off a staggered region rollout for v3.2.1 — order = US -> EU -> APAC. Warm-up window 11:00-12:00 PT. Pinning v3.2.1 for the sequence. @sre-oncall @ryan please confirm capacity.

deploy-bot: /deploy start --version v3.2.1 --regions us,eu,apac --strategy staggered --warmup 10m
deploy-bot: Initiating canary in us-west1. Warm pool prefilled: 40 GPUs. Expected token throughput +15-20%.

ryan: Confirmed. Current pool sizes: US=120 nodes (40 warm), EU=80 (20 warm), APAC=50 (10 warm). Thermal headroom OK for US at this ramp. We'll keep thresholds: p95 latency < 180ms, error-rate < 1%.

mei: Noted. I'll enable extra KV-cache priming for chat-heavy routes in US canary to reduce cold cache penalty.

alina: Rolling 20% traffic to US canary slice over 8 minutes. If any SLO breach or >0.8% error spike, we hold and triage.

deploy-bot: US canary traffic at 20% -> systems green. p95=140ms, error-rate=0.4%, GPU util 62%.

marco: Observing small increase in backend queue length on connector pod group A. Watching, but within safe margin.

ryan: Looks fine. Proceeding to ramp to 50% in US over next 15m. EU will remain pinned to v3.2.0 until US stabilizes.

deploy-bot: US ramp to 50% complete. p95=155ms, error-rate=0.6%, cost per token +4% measured.

alina: US stable. Preparing EU canary: we'll route 10% to eu-west and watch for model regressions and latency changes. Oncall, any known regional infra events? @sre-oncall

sre-oncall: No scheduled infra maintenance in EU. Network egress looks clean. I'll be live on this thread and Pager duty if needed.

deploy-bot: EU canary live: 10% -> initial metrics: p95=190ms, error-rate=1.9% :rotating_light:

mei: Uh — the EU error-rate is above threshold (1%). Looking at logs, we see a spike of 504s from the embedding service between eu-west1 zones 2 and 3.

ryan: Can we isolate to model variant? Is this KV-cache coldness or infra 504s?

mei: It's upstream 504s not direct model errors. However end-user errors show up as rate-limited fallbacks and timeouts.

alina: Given EU >1% and degradations, put EU canary on hold. We should rollback EU slice to v3.2.0 and maintain US on v3.2.1. APAC hold until EU cleared.

deploy-bot: Rolling back eu-west1 canary to v3.2.0...
deploy-bot: rollback command: /deploy rollback --region eu --from v3.2.1 --to v3.2.0 --reason "upstream 504 spike"
deploy-bot: rollback complete. EU traffic now pinned to v3.2.0. Metrics: p95=170ms, error-rate=0.3%.

sre-oncall: Confirming rollback applied. Filed incident #INC-2026-042, tagging net-team to investigate the cross-zone egress 504s.

marco: Good call. Let's avoid global rollback — US is fine and APAC not yet touched. We'll capture the canary logs and share with net-team.

alina: Agreed. Action items: 1) net-team triages 504s in EU (assign to @marco). 2) follow-up postmortem and release notes entry describing partial rollback and rationale. 3) schedule a re-run of EU canary after fix and a longer warmup (20m) and additional KV priming.

marco: Taking the net ticket. I'll post a short update in #incidents once we know root cause.

ryan: After net fix, let's also run a model-quality smoke test against EU traffic replay to ensure no regression.

alina: Thanks team. Closing this thread when epic PR with release notes and incident link is created. :thumbsup:
